title: Strict regular-system comparison for the completed unit
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a finite-field datum D of characteristic different from l, a scheme W, and a supplied coefficient-derived-system calculus S as in [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], choose finite identifications b_n between evaluation of the regular sequence-site module and the actual finite regular module which are identities on all sections, as in [def-pur-completed-unit-pullback-data]. There exists an isomorphism c from S.reduction of the completed regular degree-zero object to the regular sequence-site degree-zero object such that evaluation of c, the exact evaluation/single comparison, and single(b_n) compose to S.reductionEvaluation followed by the actual constantCoefficientReductionMap at every level. This asserts an isomorphism of whole systems before evaluation, not a lifting from arbitrary finite derived maps.

source.place: Sections 3.5 and 6.5, Lemmas 6.5.9 and 6.8.2; regular-module calculation in lem-pur-completed-unit-pullback-tower

proof.text: Apply the simultaneous reductionModel to the flat-term K-flat regular single complex. At each level ordinary tensor multiplication is an isomorphism to the finite regular single complex, with inverse z to 1 tensor z. These maps commute with the actual quotient transitions and assemble to mutually inverse chain maps on the ringed sequence site. Localize the chain isomorphism and compose with the supplied simultaneous representative comparison. The actual finite reduction map is the transpose of the completed coefficient projection, hence the reductionModel evaluation equation gives precisely the asserted equation. The section condition on b removes arbitrary scalar automorphisms. This works also on the empty site and at exponent one.

lean.statement:
theorem completedUnitStrictComparison (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (W : Scheme.{u})
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W)
    (b : ∀ n : ℕ, (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).obj (systemUnit l E W) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (integralCoefficientSheaf l E W n))
    (hb : ∀ (n : ℕ) (V : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).obj (systemUnit l E W)).val.obj V),
      HEq ((b n).hom.val.app V x) x) :
    ∃ c : S.reduction.obj (integralConstantCoefficientObject l E W) ≅ systemObject l E W,
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W n).map c.hom ≫
          (evaluationSingle l E W n).hom ≫
          (@DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ _ _ (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) 0).map
            (b n).hom =
        (S.reductionEvaluation n).hom.app (integralConstantCoefficientObject l E W) ≫
          constantCoefficientReductionMap l E W n
